outcome: Reduce the server's Codex audit cost while preserving Astra, immutable evidence and independent audit criteria.
constraints: Official ChatGPT authentication and read-only Codex execution
No repeated inference after an ambiguous charge
Company records remain in this repository
No scientific trials or market orders

deliverables.description: Stop unchanged or unsuccessful audit loops
acceptance: Nonpass verdicts and audit runtime failures wait for explicit remediation
Existing runaway audit is held with a durable receipt
Audit inference has finite turn and token budgets

deliverables.description: Batch immutable evidence and verify actual delivery
acceptance: No evidence is counted without a completed bound model request containing its bytes
Bounded packet reviews persist digest-bound observations
Final audit retains causal code and observations

deliverables.description: Reuse the audit's explicit Codex session
acceptance: Only the exact completed predecessor can be resumed
Account, model, attempt and ambiguous-receipt boundaries fail closed

deliverables.description: Validate and apply scoped runtime changes
acceptance: Real PostgreSQL regressions and runtime receipt tests pass
Production change and measured limits are recorded
Offline savings are distinguished from observed model usage

stopConditions: Do not publish nonpass research as verified
